title: 第970章 黑魔原深处谁在害怕浪爷第969章 映照神灵在世时的异象
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
轰隆隆——
地动山摇！
一朵又一朵恐怖的鬼神云，从高空飞速的坠下，七彩流光氤氲交织，轰然砸在了地面之上。
整座黑魔原都在震动，有龟裂开来的裂纹，飞速的蔓延，嗤嗤嗤的热气，从破裂开的裂缝之中冲天而起。
七彩色的流光弥漫，笼罩整座黑魔原，使得黑魔原一瞬间，好似变成了七彩色的场域，但是这七彩色的流光很快就消散开来，变成了浓烈且活跃的鬼神之力！
“鬼神云爆爆发之时，天地之间的鬼神之力会变得极其活跃，变成了可怕的毒药！”
“这个时候若是修炼，牵引鬼神之力入金丹，只会让体内的地脉金丹，被彻底引爆，使得鬼神之力被侵染，被调动活跃……有堕落风险！”
风流呼啸，狂风随着那些鬼神云，砸在黑魔原的地面之上，爆裂炸开之时，不断的狂飙。
孔渔被吹的衣裙狂舞，血红发丝飘荡，不过她修为强大，地源境修为，在这一种狂风中稳住身形倒不是什么难事。
而李浪就更不会感觉到有多少影响了。
倒是陈丹求，不得不催动鬼神之力，竭尽全力的抵抗着风流的吹拂，否则的话，他会被这风给吹的横飞而出，直至被吹到黑魔原的边沿区域。
李浪闭目，感知着这股从黑魔原深处吹拂喷薄而出的强大冲击力。
“地源境之下，都不得不催动鬼神之力以抵抗这吹拂之力。”
李浪睁开眼眸，沉声说道。
陈丹求早已祭出鬼神之力护罩，面容之上满是难看之色：“可是，祭出鬼神之力护罩，体内的鬼神之力就会不断的消耗。”
“一旦消耗过大，就不得不吸收天地间的鬼神之力来补充……”
陈丹求吐出一口气。
“而一旦补充，就容易被活跃且疯狂的鬼神之力所影响，继而堕落侵蚀。”
李浪点了点头，他也察觉到了这一点。
“这就是鬼神云爆……”

“风险与机遇并存！”
孔渔目光灼灼说道：“扛住鬼神云爆的力量，会有机会得到各种各样的，从黑魔原深处被这股风流给吹拂带动出来的宝物。”
“陈叔，若是扛不住了，就吸收鬼兽丹中的鬼神之力。”
李浪屈指一叩鬼神空饰，将之前得获的诸多普通一些的鬼兽丹，纷纷取出，递给了陈丹求。
地玄境、地煞境的鬼兽丹，对李浪而言，效果不算太强大。
如今的李浪，对鬼兽丹的要求很高。
只有地源境以及半步天纹境的鬼兽丹，才能满足他的修炼需求。
普通的鬼兽丹，李浪就不是那么需要。
陈丹求也没有矫情，毕竟关乎到生命危险，一旦地脉金丹中的鬼神之力耗尽，陈丹求就不得不从天地中吸收鬼神之力，就有侵蚀堕落成为鬼神人奴的风险。
所以，从鬼兽丹中吸收鬼神之力，维持地脉金丹的运转，就很重要了。
李浪肉身强大，不在乎鬼神云爆的侵蚀，他单靠肉身就能扛住这股力量。
而孔渔乃是地源境，也能扛得住。
唯有他陈丹求需要，陈丹求自然不矫情。
孔渔好似想到了什么，忽而看向了李浪，面色沉凝起来：“主人，我们得抓紧时间了。”
“鬼神云爆爆发，机缘开启，我们必须快速赶赴到黑魔原的核心区域的边沿位置。”
“黑魔原的核心区我们不得进入，这是族中长辈叮嘱的，但是，核心区域的边沿，就是我们所能取得的最大机缘之地。”
“首先鬼神云爆的爆发之地是核心区，鬼神云爆中所蕴含的宝物、机缘等等，都是从核心区吹拂而出的，我们只要占据核心区，就能成为第一波筛选宝物之人。”
“神灵洞府亦是位于那儿。”
“这一次鬼神云爆开启，那座神灵洞府就会显现而出，但是维持的时间并不长久，一旦错过，就等于错过了开启的机会，再无进入的机会了。”
孔渔的面色很严肃。

“那我们走吧。”
content_en:
Rumble——
The earth shook!
One after another, terrifying ghost clouds fell rapidly from high altitudes, colorful streams of light intertwined, and crashed onto the ground.
The entire Black Demon Plain was shaking, cracks were opening, and they were spreading rapidly, and hot air was rising into the sky from the cracks.
The seven-color stream of light filled the air and enveloped the entire Black Demon Plain, making the Black Demon Plain instantly seem to turn into a seven-color field. However, the seven-color stream of light quickly dissipated and turned into a strong and active power of ghosts and gods!
"When the ghost cloud explodes, the power of ghosts and gods between heaven and earth will become extremely active and turn into a terrible poison!"
"If you practice at this time and draw the power of ghosts and gods into the golden elixir, it will only completely detonate the golden elixir of the earth veins in the body, causing the power of ghosts and gods to be infected and mobilized... there is a risk of corruption!"
The wind roared, and the strong wind followed the ghost clouds and hit the ground of the Black Demon Field. When it exploded, it continued to surge wildly.
Kong Yu's blown dress danced wildly, and her blood-red hair fluttered. However, her cultivation was strong and she was in the Earth Origin Realm. It was not difficult to stabilize her figure in such a strong wind.
And Li Lang would not feel much influence.
Chen Danqiu, on the other hand, had to use the power of ghosts and gods to resist the wind with all his strength. Otherwise, he would be blown away by the wind until he was blown to the edge of the Black Demon Field.
Li Lang closed his eyes and felt the powerful impact blowing out from the depths of the Black Demon Field.
"Under the Earth Origin Realm, one has to mobilize the power of ghosts and gods to resist the blowing force."
Li Lang opened his eyes and said in a deep voice.
Chen Danqiu had already used the power of ghosts and gods to protect him, and his face was filled with an ugly look: "However, if you use the power of ghosts and gods to protect you, the power of ghosts and gods in your body will continue to be consumed."
"Once the consumption is too large, we have to absorb the power of ghosts and gods in the world to replenish it..."
Chen Danqiu let out a breath.
"Once it is replenished, it will be easily affected by the active and crazy power of ghosts and gods, and then corrupted."
Li Lang nodded, and he also noticed this.
"This is the Ghost Cloud Blast..."
"Risks and opportunities coexist!"
Kong Yu said with glaring eyes: "Withstand the power of the ghost cloud explosion, you will have the opportunity to obtain various treasures that are blown out by this wind from the depths of the Black Demon Field."
"Uncle Chen, if you can't bear it anymore, absorb the power of ghosts and gods in the ghost beast pill."
Li Lang tapped the ghost and god ornaments with his fingers, took out the many ordinary ghost and beast pills he had obtained before, and handed them to Chen Danqiu.
For Li Lang, the ghost beast pills in the Earth Xuan Realm and Earth Evil Realm are not too powerful.
Today, Li Lang has very high requirements for ghost beast pills.
Only the Ghost Beast Pills from the Earth Origin Realm and the Half-Step Heavenly Pattern Realm can satisfy his cultivation needs.
Li Lang doesn't need ordinary ghost beast pills.
Chen Danqiu was not being pretentious. After all, his life was in danger. Once the power of ghosts and gods in the golden elixir of the earth was exhausted, Chen Danqiu had to absorb the power of ghosts and gods from heaven and earth, and there was a risk of erosion and degeneration into a slave of ghosts, gods, and humans.
Therefore, it is very important to absorb the power of ghosts and gods from the ghost beast elixir and maintain the operation of the earth vein elixir.
Li Lang's physical body is strong and he doesn't care about the erosion of ghosts and gods. He can withstand this power with his physical body alone.
Kong Yu is in the Earth Origin Realm and can handle it.
Only he, Chen Danqiu, needs it, and Chen Danqiu is naturally not pretentious.
Kong Yu seemed to have thought of something, and suddenly looked at Li Lang, his expression serious: "Master, we have to hurry up."
"The ghost cloud explodes and an opportunity opens. We must rush to the edge of the core area of the Black Demon Plain."
"We are not allowed to enter the core area of ​​the Black Demon Plains. This is what the elders of the clan have told us. However, the edge of the core area is where we have the greatest opportunity."
"First of allThe place where the ghost cloud burst explodes is the core area. The treasures, opportunities, etc. contained in the ghost cloud explosion are blown out from the core area. As long as we occupy the core area, we can become the first wave of people to screen the treasures. "
“The Divine Cave is also located there. "
"This time when the Ghost Cloud Explosion is activated, the Spirit Cave will appear, but it will not last long. Once it is missed, it will be equivalent to missing the opportunity to open it, and there will be no chance to enter again. "
Kong Yu's face was serious.
"Then let's go. "
